intro.text: A soldier in the Kholinar Wall Guard who serves in the same squad as Kaladin.

items.text: Alaward got to know Kaladin as a squadmate. He and Vaceslv kept trying to get Kaladin to play cards with them, but Kaladin always declined.

Alaward followed Kaladin into Kholinar's palace with his squad and fought in the battle there. Most of the squad, including Noro and Beard, were killed; Alaward isn't mentioned among the few survivors.

appearance.text: A heavyset man with light eyes, though only of the tenth dahn, the lowest rank of lighteyes.

personality.text: He thinks middle-ranking lighteyes are useless, and once told Adolin, disguised as one, that they were good for nothing but giving bad orders and eating twice as much as an honest man.
